newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa lists soaring drug seizures.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa lists soaring drug seizures.

text.p: Police Minister Sydney Mufamadi on Wednesday released figures on South Africa's soaring drug trade problem, including the seizure of 121.2 tonnes of cocaine at border posts last year.
Replying to questions in parliament, Mufamadi said the 1996 cocaine seizures compared with 33.7 kg seized in 1994, when South Africa had yet to throw off its isolation of the apartheid decades.
Police had confiscated 36.8 tonnes of cocaine and two tonnes of heroine at border posts between January and April this year, Mufamadi said.

Police have in recent years reported increasing use of South Africa as a transit point or market for drugs originating in South America and Asia. The country has experienced soaring growth in air traffic since apartheid ended with democratic elections in April 1994.
